purpose: Build admissible prospective feature history for already-frozen external family handoffs without importing economic direction, thresholds, winners, or prior PnL.
prospective_d0_rule: For each family, D0 is its first successful live collection attempt executed by the merged collector workflow after this preregistration is present on main. Earlier validation snapshots receive zero prospective or economic credit.

collection_cadence.meaning: collection cadence only; it does not define an economic horizon, threshold, lookback, or entry/exit rule

persistence.format: append-only JSONL per family plus latest STATUS.json
persistence.persisted_payload: derived frozen features, source-quality state, timestamps, extractor exit status, and GitHub provenance
persistence.full_capture_evidence: uploaded as GitHub Actions artifact with finite retention; runtime history stores the derived admissible feature record and provenance, not the bulky raw/event corpus

missing_or_ineligible_policy: Persist explicit UNAVAILABLE/ABSTAIN state; never zero-fill missing features and never silently drop an attempted observation.
